current_managed_authoring_policy: One private shared lookup admits supported explicit V8 authorable contracts (unchanged V7 plus profile edit). Current authority and role validation use it while retaining host decisions, deprecation, actor/source, deadline and cancellation checks. Embedded historical registry membership alone is not current signing permission.
domain: Typed keep/set/clear for seven profile fields; no unknown or raw-JSON setter.
baseline: Exact verified admitted canonical kind-0 head, matching expected author and advancing timestamp. Nonempty baseline tags refuse. Runtime persists and rechecks the actual canonical baseline before signing or side effects.
preservation: Every untouched raw JSON field value remains exact, including residual wrong types, nested duplicate names and numeric lexemes. Top-level duplicate keys remain rejected.
media: Kept string media requires matching byte-verified image proof. Explicit clear or typed replacement is supported. Proof does not establish BUD-02 completion, network availability or image decode safety.
history: V7 source/inventory/vectors and existing strict initial/full-replacement authoring remain unchanged. V8 inherits exact V7 inventory and adds only the profile-edit operation. Existing generic signing and durable storage semantics apply.
